description: This file defines an Angular component called TaskListComponent that manages a list of tasks. It includes functionality for fetching, displaying, filtering, creating, editing, toggling completion, and deleting tasks. The component interacts with TaskService for data operations and NotificationService for user notifications.

classes.name: TaskListComponent
classes.description: Angular component responsible for displaying and managing a list of tasks, including filtering, creation, editing, toggling completion, and deletion.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that initiates fetching of tasks when the component is initialized.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the list of tasks from the TaskService and updates the component state.

methods.name: startCreate
methods.description: Prepares the component state to create a new task.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Sets the component to editing mode for the selected task.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new task via the TaskService and updates the task list.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task via the TaskService and reflects changes in the task list.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task via the TaskService.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task after user confirmation and updates the task list.
